## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth who possesses a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is a large, heavy youth of twenty with a round, expressionless face. He is characterized by a stolid demeanor and a noticeable, painful lack of conversational ability.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## History

Billy drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Jane to the charity concert held at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Following the successful performance and post-concert discussions among the girls, he drove them back home under the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is Billy's sister. During a charity concert event at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), Billy provides transportation for Jane, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), driving them to the venue and later taking them home under the moonlight while the group discusses the evening.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), +6 more_
